remarks: Striking modern colonial with open floor plan in sought-after Christopher Estates conveniently located on the Westport-Norwalk line. This home has been completely renovated inside and out with attention to detail. The dramatic foyer welcomes you to a great home for entertaining. Grill in comfort under the gazebo with a cooling fan to escape the summertime heat as friends gather on the large deck, around the fire-pit, or lounge in the picture-perfect yard. Dine al fresco under the stars or in the large formal dining room. The stunning cook's kitchen is complete with gas dual fuel GE Cafe range, subzero wine refrigerator, high-end refrigerator, new custom cabinets, quartz counters, and sparklingbrushed bronze hardware. The sun-filled eating area opens to both family room with surround sound entertainment and the backyard oasis. You can even relax in the heated, tricked out garage. The powder room off foyer is freshly renovated. Upstairs there is a luxurious primary suite with spa bath and large custom walk in closet. There is a spacious laundry room, 3 additional bedrooms, and an updated hall bath. The lower level is open with high ceilings and plenty of room for expansion. Close to Norwalk and Westport restaurants and stores, beaches, and commuting. This home is convenient to all Fairfield County has to enjoy. You will love living here!
